tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background: the paper every screen sits on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs, the sticky action bar and the tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Skeleton blocks, code and math blocks, empty thumbnails. Text on it is `text` or `text-muted` only.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Ink: all body text, headings, every 2px border and the hard shadow. 16.1:1 on bg, 14.5:1 on surface-sunken (light); 15.8:1 and 12.1:1 (dark).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, durations, disabled and locked outlines; on bg, surface or surface-sunken (5.6:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one primary action per screen, links, selected state and the dashed focus ring. As text, on bg or surface only (4.9:1 light, 8.5:1 dark); not on surface-sunken in light (4.4:1).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on a `primary` fill: 5.0:1 light, 9.5:1 dark. Never literal white in dark mode.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Passed checkpoints and done actions; always with the check icon and a word ("Passed"), never colour alone. Text on bg or surface.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention (server waking up, low credits); with the alert icon and a word. Text on bg or surface only.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors only, with the alert icon and a word. Close to `success` in lightness (1.0:1), so the two are never told apart by colour: icon and word carry it.

tokens.name: stage-novice
tokens.usage: Dreyfus stage 1 marks: badge dot, grid hatching and outlines. Never text: the stage name is always written in `text` beside it. 4.2:1 on bg (light).

tokens.name: stage-advanced-beginner
tokens.usage: Dreyfus stage 2 marks; never text. 3.6:1 on bg (light), above the 3:1 floor for marks.

tokens.name: stage-competent
tokens.usage: Dreyfus stage 3 marks; never text. 4.2:1 on bg (light).

tokens.name: stage-proficient
tokens.usage: Dreyfus stage 4 marks; never text. Close in lightness to stage-competent, so the grid's row label carries the difference.

tokens.name: stage-expert
tokens.usage: Dreyfus stage 5 marks; never text. 6.1:1 on bg (light), 5.6:1 (dark).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Hand-lettered. Headings, the wordmark, empty-state captions and short annotations only; never below 18px.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Learn SQL, one step at a time

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: H3, card titles on overview screens, empty-state captions.

styles.name: annotation
styles.usage: Short notes beside content: "why this", the video segment, "you are here". One line, six words or fewer.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Everything a learner reads, taps or types.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Resource and step titles inside cards.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick the topic you want to get better at.
styles.usage: Default UI and body text; also inputs (16px stops iOS zoom).

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: Open the query editor and run the first SELECT on the orders table.
styles.usage: SOP step text, set at a 68ch max width.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, chips, tab labels, field labels.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code in SOP steps and code answers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges; hatching pitch.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the page gutter at 360px.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between screen regions.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of empty states and the first-visit Today screen.

radius.note: Straight radii exist only for pills; every other shape uses a wobble.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, the tab highlight.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Stage dots, the quiz option letter.

wobble.note: Hand-drawn corners: asymmetric elliptical border-radius. Never on text-only elements.

tokens.name: wobble-card
tokens.usage: Cards, toasts, the video frame, empty-state frames.

tokens.name: wobble-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, quiz options.

tokens.name: wobble-blob
tokens.usage: The active-tab highlight and icon badges.

tokens.name: stroke-ink
tokens.usage: Every border and SVG line.

tokens.name: stroke-strong
tokens.usage: Selected and current states, the focus ring.

shadow.note: Hard offset, never blurred. Pressed controls move 2px and drop it.

tokens.name: shadow-sketch
tokens.usage: Cards, toasts, the primary button at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-sketch-sm
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, quiz options, chips that are tappable.
